why: Mostly seasonal park that fails long-stay test 4 and the Google screen. On Campspot (park 6132, read 2026-11-22), only 14 of the map's 156 RV pads are sold by the night, about 9% and under 1 in 10. Seven of those are 'Exclusive' sites bookable only within 15 days. The operator site stayhappycampers.com (read 2026-11-22 in a headless browser after Cloudflare refused curl) calls it 'a seasonal campground' and sells sites through a '2027 Camp Agreement', with deck and firepit permits. Google rates it 3.7 from 64 reviews (gm.py, 2026-11-22), under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. The price only just meets the gate: $50.00 for a 30A full-hookup weeknight plus a $3 per-stay campground fee, with no gateway within 40 km.
name: Happy Campers Campground
inclusion_evidence: Operator site stayhappycampers.com (read 2026-11-22 through the headless browser; curl got a Cloudflare 403). It calls itself 'a seasonal campground located in beautiful Chamberlain'. It says 'Every seasonal campsite lot comes set up with 50 Amp Power, Water & Sewer Hookups', sells sites through a '2027 Camp Agreement' and a 'Join Waiting List' / 'Priority Contact List', and requires deck, firepit and landscaping permits. It also links 'Book Overnight on Campspot'. Campspot engine happycamperscampground, park 6132 'Happy Campers LLC ... d/b/a Happy Campers Campground', 2010 E King St, Chamberlain (operator pin 43.767732,-99.31188), read 2026-11-22. It sells 14 RV sites by the night: 30A FHU 030-033, 50A FHU 034-036, 'Exclusive' 30A 58/67 and 'Exclusive' 50A 100/54/59/46/49. The Exclusive sites carry BOOKING_IN_ADVANCE_LIMITS_RULE 'Cannot book more than 15 days in advance', so they look like released seasonal pads. There are also 6 primitive tent sites. Rigs fit to 35-60 ft. No closures are posted, and the park was open on every date read (Nov 2026, Jan, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Sep and Oct 2027). The Campspot park-map SVG (park-maps.campspot.com/71d997d1-...) draws 239 campsite shapes: 73 storage units, 10 small squares (6 tent sites, 3 shelters, 1 community room) and 156 RV pads. So 14/156 = 9.0% are nightly, and only 7/156 (4.5%) can be booked more than 15 days ahead. That fails test 4 (at least 1 site in 10 nightly). Esri imagery (rendered, 2026-11-22) shows the dense rows of parked trailers and the storage-building strip along I-90 that the map draws. PRICE: 30A Full Hookup Site $50.00 x 1 night + 'Campground Fees' $3.00 per stay (a 2-night quote is $100 + $3) = $53 for one night, 2 adults, Tue 2027-06-08. It is the same on every weeknight read in any season; Saturday 2027-07-17 is $52.50 + $3. 50A FHU is $55 + $3, and Exclusive sites are $55 / $57.50 + $3. The base meets the US$50 gate exactly, and the per-stay fee puts a one-night stay $3 over. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Badlands NP 211 km). Google Maps 3.7 from 64 reviews (gm.py 2026-11-22, place 43.76775,-99.31205, phone +1 605-597-3394). Campspot rating 3.8 from 4.
flags: Three tests fail or only just pass, and either of the first two is enough to skip: (1) nightly share 14 of 156 RV pads = 9%, half of them sold only within 15 days; (2) Google 3.7 from 64 reviews; (3) price $50.00 base + $3 per-stay fee, exactly at the gate before the fee.

Not in campgrounds.json: no SD entry within 15 km by pin, and no 'Happy Campers' / Chamberlain / Oacoma entry by name (2026-11-22). The nearest is 5726 Dude Ranch LUA, 8 km away. Chamberlain/Oacoma appears to hold no other DB campground at all (American Creek, Al's Oasis and Cedar Shore are not entries); that may be worth a look as a separate lead.
Sister parks of the same owners (per the operator footer): Dakota Sunsets (Salem SD, lead 3), Betts Campground (entry 5800) and Valhalla Campground, Lake Shetek MN.
